att02_check_in_time) - (att01_break_minutes * INTERVAL '1 minute') )) || '분' ) ELSE '' END ) AS att02_work_time_str

mapper.insert: INSERT INTO att02_commute ( att02_commute_id , att02_company_id , att02_person_id , att02_work_date , att02_check_in_time , att02_check_out_time , att02_batch_yn ) SELECT f_create_seq() , #{companyId} , #{personId} , d.work_date , (d.work_date::text||' '||wp.att01_work_start_time)::timestamp , (d.work_date::text||' '||wp.att01_work_end_time)::timestamp , 'true' FROM (SELECT generate_series(#{startDate}::date,#{closeDate}::date,INTERVAL '1 day')::date AS work_date) d JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT * FROM att01_work_policy wp WHERE wp.att01_company_id = #{companyId} AND wp.att01_start_date <= d.work_date AND wp.att01_use_yn = 'true' ORDER BY wp.att01_start_date DESC LIMIT 1 ) wp ON TRUE WHERE 1=1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM att02_commute c WHERE c.att02_company_id = #{companyId} AND c.att02_person_id = #{personId} AND c.att02_work_date = d.work_date ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM emp20_leave l WHERE l.emp20_company_id = #{companyId} AND l.emp20_person_id = #{personId} AND d.work_date BETWEEN l.emp20_start_date AND l.emp20_close_date AND COALESCE(l.emp20_cancel, 'false') = 'false' ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys12_calendar s WHERE s.sys12_company_id = #{companyId} AND s.sys12_day = d.work_date AND s.sys12_working_yn = 'false' )
